protocol.name: arlen_wallpaper_pause_v1

description.summary: tell a wallpaper why it is not being shown

protocol.description: A wallpaper on the background layer draws only when the compositor asks it to, with wl_surface.frame callbacks, and a covered or locked wallpaper is simply not asked. That stops it drawing, but it cannot tell the two apart: a covered wallpaper should keep its place and resume the moment it is seen, while a locked session is a reason to stop a video, release a decoder or drop to a still frame. This protocol says which.

interface.name: arlen_wallpaper_pause_manager_v1
interface.description: Global. Any client may bind it; a pause object can only ever describe a surface of the client that created it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Pause objects already created stay valid.

request.name: get_pause

description.summary: watch why a surface is or is not being shown

request.description: The compositor sends the surface's state on the next frame it considers it, and again on every change.

description.summary: why one surface is or is not being shown

entry.name: running
entry.summary: the surface can be seen and is given frames

entry.name: covered
entry.summary: nothing of the surface can be seen; frames resume when it can

entry.name: locked
entry.summary: the session is locked; frames resume only after it is unlocked

event.name: state
event.description: Locked wins over covered: a locked session also covers the wallpaper, and the lock is the reason that matters.
